key_insights: Holistic review evaluates a student's full range of experiences and attributes, not just grades and test scores
Purpose is to build a diverse, dynamic student body and predict success beyond what standardized metrics capture alone
Socioeconomic background, educational opportunities, and family responsibilities are explicitly factored into evaluation
Many institutions use a multi-reader system where several admissions officers independently review each application

'Contextualized review' means judging achievement relative to the opportunities available, so strong grades at an under-resourced school can be viewed more favorably than similar grades from a well-resourced one
